seoTitle: Orphan Black Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Orphan Black test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Sarah, Cosima, Alison, Helena, Rachel, Felix, Mrs S or Art — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the street-smart survivor, the curious scientist, or the soccer mum with a glue gun? Answer 11 everyday questions about family, secrets and keeping it together, and find out which Orphan Black character you are.

characters.name: Sarah Manning
characters.title: The Survivor
characters.summary: Street-smart, fearless and fiercely protective. You think on your feet, and you'd do anything for your family.
description: Like Sarah, you're street-smart. She's a small-time con artist who grew up as an orphan in foster care.
You'd do anything for family. Sarah is the only one of the clones with a biological daughter, Kira.
You think on your feet. After a chance encounter with Beth, a woman who looks exactly like her, Sarah takes over Beth's identity.
characters.flaw: You run first, and think about it later.
characters.signature: A fake ID, a quick lie and a family you'd fight for.
characters.clashReason: they'd lie to your face, then win you over anyway

characters.name: Cosima Niehaus
characters.title: The Scientist
characters.summary: Curious, brilliant and laid-back. You want to understand how everything works, and you stay hopeful when things get hard.
description: Like Cosima, you're endlessly curious. She's a graduate student studying evolutionary developmental biology.
You want to understand everything. Cosima researches the science behind the clones.
You stay hopeful, even in hard times. Cosima is seriously ill for much of the series, and keeps working anyway.
characters.flaw: You get so caught up in the science that you forget to look after yourself.
characters.signature: A lab coat, a big idea and a theory you can't wait to test.
characters.clashReason: they'd want to analyse everything you do

characters.name: Alison Hendrix
characters.title: The Perfectionist
characters.summary: Organised, determined and secretly a little chaotic. You like everything just so, and you're tougher than anyone thinks.
description: Like Alison, you like things just so. She's a soccer mum trying to be the perfect housewife.
You've got a crafty side. Alison has a basement craft room, and she's handy with a glue gun.
You're tougher than you look. Alison once ties her husband to a chair in that craft room.
characters.flaw: You're so busy keeping up appearances that you forget to relax.
characters.signature: A colour-coded planner, a glue gun and a spotless kitchen.
characters.clashReason: they'd reorganise your whole life, whether you asked or not

characters.name: Helena
characters.title: The Wild One
characters.summary: Fierce, unpredictable and loyal to the bone. You don't play by anyone's rules, and you'd fight the world for your family.
description: Like Helena, you're fiercely loyal. She's Sarah's twin sister.
You've had a tough start. Helena was raised to be an assassin by a religious group called the Proletheans.
You'd do anything to protect the kids in your life. Helena fights off armed attackers to keep the children safe.
characters.flaw: You don't always know where the line is.
characters.signature: A big hug, a wild look and a family you'd fight anyone for.
characters.clashReason: they'd hug you a bit too hard, for a bit too long

characters.name: Rachel Duncan
characters.title: The Executive
characters.summary: Ambitious, composed and always in control. You plan three steps ahead, and you never let anyone see you sweat.
description: Like Rachel, you like to be in control. She's an executive at the Dyad Institute.
You've always known exactly who you are. Rachel was raised knowing she was a clone.
You keep your options open. Rachel ends up working with the secretive group Neolution.
characters.flaw: You'd rather be feared than be close to anyone.
characters.signature: A cold stare, perfect posture and a plan three steps ahead.
characters.clashReason: they'd treat you like one of their employees

characters.name: Felix
characters.title: The Best Friend
characters.summary: Dramatic, witty and creative. You're everyone's ride-or-die, and you make sure life is never boring.
description: Like Felix, you're dramatic and creative. He's Sarah's foster brother, and he sees himself as a modern artist.
You're the best friend anyone could ask for. Felix is Sarah's closest confidant.
You're there when it counts. Felix helps Sarah and the other clones through crisis after crisis.
characters.flaw: You turn everything into a drama, even when it isn't one.
characters.signature: Paint on your hands, a witty comment and a sister you'd do anything for.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a dramatic scene about something tiny

characters.name: Mrs S
characters.title: The Protector
characters.summary: Tough, resourceful and full of secrets. You'd do anything to protect your family, even if you don't tell them how.
description: Like Mrs S, you're tough and resourceful. She's Sarah and Felix's foster mother.
You can keep a secret. Mrs S hid Sarah for years.
You'd give anything to protect your family. Mrs S dies fighting one of the clones' enemies.
characters.flaw: You keep so many secrets that even your family isn't sure they can trust you.
characters.signature: A calm voice, an old contact and a plan nobody else knows about.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you half the story, and expect you to trust them

characters.name: Art Bell
characters.title: The Detective
characters.summary: Steady, decent and dependable. You like things done properly, and you stand by the people who need you.
description: Like Art, you're steady and decent. He's a police detective, and Beth's partner.
You care about the people you work with. Art cares deeply about Beth.
You do the right thing in the end. Art sides with the clones, and helps them.
characters.flaw: You like things done by the book, even when the book doesn't help.
characters.signature: A badge, a notebook and a lot of patience.
characters.clashReason: they'd ask a lot of questions you don't want to answer

questions.text: You're running late for something important. You...

options.text: Talk your way out of it with a very creative excuse
Text everyone a detailed apology and a new arrival time
Arrive fashionably late, and make an entrance
Get distracted by something interesting on the way

questions.text: You've got a free Saturday. You spend it...

options.text: Organising your cupboards, and loving every minute
Painting, and maybe going to a party later
Reading about something fascinating, for hours
Eating all of your favourite food

questions.text: Someone threatens a person you love. You...

options.text: Get them somewhere safe first, and keep them close
Handle the threat yourself, whatever it takes
Call in a favour from someone dangerous
Go to the police, and do it properly

questions.text: You have to work with someone you can't stand. You...

options.text: Make it very clear who's in charge
Smile politely, then complain about them at home
Roll your eyes, constantly, where only your friends can see
Keep your head down, and stay out of their way

questions.text: A friend has a wild theory about something. You...

options.text: Love it. Let's test it
Ask for evidence
Hear them out, then make your own plan
Dismiss it, coolly, in one sentence

questions.text: You find out someone lied to you for years. You...

options.text: Storm off, then come back once you've cooled down
Understand. You've kept a few secrets yourself
Feel betrayed, but forgive them if they're family
Make a big, dramatic scene about it

questions.text: You're put in charge of a neighbourhood event. You...

options.text: Make colour-coded spreadsheets and matching T-shirts
Hire professionals. You don't do community events
Turn it into the party of the year, whatever the budget
Find a way to get out of it

questions.text: You make a mistake that could get you in real trouble. You...

options.text: Panic, then cover it up very neatly
Run, and fix it later
Never admit it
Confess. You couldn't live with it otherwise

questions.text: A friend is sick and scared. You...

options.text: Stay positive, and look up every treatment there is
Sit by their bed, and refuse to leave
Quietly take care of everything, without being asked
Cheer them up with outrageous gossip

questions.text: You find out there are other people who look exactly like you. You...

options.text: Pretend to be one of them, if it helps you
Want to study exactly how it happened
Keep it quiet. What would the neighbours think?
Want to be the one in control of all of them

questions.text: A long-lost sibling turns up, and they're a bit strange. You...

options.text: Hug them, a little too hard
Relax. Strange is fine by you
Check them out thoroughly before trusting them
Quietly make sure they're not in any trouble with the law
